title: [epic] RocksDB block store backend
description:
## Why
RocksDB is an LSM-tree embedded KV store with higher write throughput than LMDB, making it a better fit for transit nodes with heavy ingest rates. Trade-off: slower point reads (LSM vs B-tree) and a C++ dependency via the `rocksdb` crate FFI. Useful for operators seeing LMDB write amplification under sustained load.

## Scope
- `[backend] type = "rocksdb"` config: `path` directory, optional `cache_size_mb`
- `RocksStore: IpfsStore` and `RocksBlockStore: IpfsBlockStore` backed by the `rocksdb` crate (column family: `blocks`, key = CID bytes, value = raw block)
- Bloom filters on the blocks CF for fast negative lookups
- Startup: open or create DB, verify writable
- Integration tests: round-trip, idempotent put, delete, concurrent reads
- RUNBOOK section with tuning notes (block cache, compaction)
